instruction.name: xvftintrne.l.d
instruction.description: Convert double-precision floating point elements in `a` to signed 64-bit integer, rounding towards nearest even.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftintrne.l.d $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrne.l.d $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrne.l.d $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrne.l.d $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrne.l.d $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrne.l.d $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrne.l.d $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrne.l.d $xr7, $xr15

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
